utilityDoctrineRequirements: opponent capability remains information-limited; utility may use own mechanics, current defensive state, observed hostile actions, and already-in-flight threats but not hidden enemy build fields
established combat prefers Active Sensor; Passive is a tactical fallback only when it improves a coherent feasible package
ECCM is considered only against observed ECM when it changes the usable track for the selected action
Tactical Power allocation and powered-system action are selected together as coherent packages rather than by a fixed subsystem priority queue
one-turn package utility is expected raw combat swing: expected damage inflicted plus expected structural damage prevented, with deterministic offense-favoring tie breaks
a sole legal Kinetic/Energy ship attack is not diverted to Held Main for ordinary shield/armor exposure; defensive diversion requires projected terminal Hull risk
Kinetic/Energy Held Main may be selected when no legal ship shot exists and a Firm terminal missile track exists; dual-main designs may split offensive and defensive banks
PDS competes by expected interception utility only for projected terminal missile threats; distant in-flight missiles do not consume terminal-defense TP merely because they exist
unknown threats may justify residual defensive readiness but cannot create invented numeric threat utility or hidden-build clairvoyance
TP-funded Shield recharge, recovery, hardening, PDS, ECM/ECCM, and main-weapon modes must not pre-consume one another through static ordering when their utility competes
finite-ammo weapons/PDS stop drawing TP after exhaustion and no optional package may recreate the CP145 legal-main starvation pathology
CP146 remains versioned and reproducible exactly on the same 252 identities and CP144 master seed before CP147 deltas are interpreted
interpretationBoundary: CP147 changes tactical decision logic and telemetry only. It does not promote or tune any weapon, Reactor, Sensor, EW, PDS, Shield, Armor, AUX, ammunition, movement, or other numerical authority.
nextStage: if native CP147 validates CP146 reproducibility, natural direct/held/PDS action switching, and no starvation/deadlock regression, rerun the broad whole-combat response surface under the accepted utility doctrine before numerical tuning or Stage B
